from build123d import *
import math

flange_width = 60.7
flange_length = 80.0
flange_thickness = 13.8
body_diameter = 49.7
body_height = 46.9
central_hole_diameter = 27.6
clearance_hole_diameter = 6.9
clearance_hole_count = 6
clearance_hole_radius = 32.3

base = Pos(0, 0, flange_thickness/2) * Box(flange_width, flange_length, flange_thickness)
body = Pos(0, 0, flange_thickness + body_height/2) * Cylinder(body_diameter/2, body_height)
result = base + body

result = result - Pos(0, 0, (flange_thickness + body_height)/2) * Cylinder(central_hole_diameter/2, flange_thickness + body_height)

for i in range(clearance_hole_count):
    angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / clearance_hole_count)
    px = clearance_hole_radius * math.cos(angle)
    py = clearance_hole_radius * math.sin(angle)
    result = result - Pos(px, py, flange_thickness/2) * Cylinder(clearance_hole_diameter/2, flange_thickness)

part = result
part.name = "flange_with_body"
export_step(part, "output.step")
